prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1263; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle was struck from the side. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the impact, and the shoulder complaints align with the nature of the crash. Over the course of fifteen visits, treatment followed a conventional progression, including physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and anti-inflammatory medication. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms improved and functional range returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury to the same body area is known to this provider or documented in available records. Billing review is ongoing for two similar charges recorded on the same day, which is being verified separately from the clinical assessment. Current status is improving, with ongoing home exercise and follow-up as needed.
